home.headline: Pressure Washing

about.photo_alt: Washing house siding with a pressure washer
about.title: Locally owned in Portland
paragraphs: Brightwater is a small, local crew cleaning homes across the Portland metro area.
Every surface gets the right method: soft washing for siding and roofs, high pressure only where it belongs, so the dirt comes off and nothing gets damaged.
You get a clear written quote, a crew that shows up on time, and a house that looks years newer when we pack up.

estimate.title: What can we clean for you?
estimate.text: Send a few details and we'll get back to you with a free, written quote.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon about your free quote.

services.name: House Washing
services.blurb: Siding, trim and eaves soft washed clean, without damaging paint.
services.intro: A gentle soft wash lifts dirt, mildew and green growth off your siding without blasting the paint, so your home looks fresh and stays protected.
includes: Vinyl, wood, Hardie and stucco siding

services.name: Driveway Cleaning
services.blurb: Oil, tire marks and grime lifted out of concrete and pavers.
services.intro: Surface cleaning gets years of dirt and stains out of your driveway and sidewalks in an even, streak-free finish.
photos: Freshly washed driveway in front of a home at dusk

services.name: Patio & Steps
services.blurb: Patios, steps and walkways cleaned and safe to walk on again.
services.intro: Moss and grime make patios and steps slick and dingy. We clean them down to the surface so they look good and are safe underfoot.

services.name: Roof & Moss Removal
services.blurb: Moss and streaks cleared off your roof with a safe soft wash.
services.intro: Portland's wet winters grow moss fast. We remove it and treat the roof with a low-pressure soft wash that won't damage shingles.

services.name: Deck & Fence Cleaning
services.blurb: Gray, weathered wood brought back before staining or just to refresh.
services.intro: Cleaning brings gray, weathered wood back to its natural color and gets it ready for a new coat of stain.
includes: Low pressure that's safe for wood

services.name: Gutter Cleaning
services.blurb: Gutters and downspouts cleared so rain goes where it should.
services.intro: Clogged gutters overflow onto siding and foundations. We clear them out by hand, flush the downspouts and haul the debris away.
photos: Worker clearing leaves from a gutter
